body:
**Unblocked (2026-07-12):** decision 1 (fold vs drop `python-project-standards`) is resolved by the **fold path** — wb#39 merged the `python-standards` skill into the workbench via spec-first intake (folding python-init/validate/fix + porting the templates), per the 2026-07-12 decision brief. The build here (command dispositions, asset rescue, `skills` CLI retirement, doc/memory hygiene, archive) can proceed on the existing plan (`_meta/plans/retire-hsb3-custom-plugins/plan.md`).

One machine-state note for the builder: `~/.claude/skills/` currently holds **8 symlinks pointing into the frozen repo** (api-server-design, comms, devcontainer-setup, github-project-board, handoff, pptx-henry, setup-project-dashboard, update-project-dashboard) — more than the plan's 2026-07-03 verification found (two healthy `~/.agents/skills/` links). Re-verify the symlink step against live disk before the archive; all 8 dangle the moment the repo directory is removed.

**Executive-desk re-triage ruling (Henry, 2026-07-16; enacting decision 0016 §6; recorded as desk decision 0017).**

**Kept open — sequenced AFTER the rebuild #111.** The residual work (repoint symlinks, migrate the 16 commands, retire hsb3-custom-plugins) is real and unblocked, but the command targets get renamed by the rebuild — enacting now would mean doing the mapping twice. Enact once against the rebuilt bundle names, as a post-#111 cleanup.

## Close-out — command disposition + symlink repoint

Repo-side work landed in **PR #209** (into `dev`, `make ci` green). Source content read
directly from `hsb3/hsb3-custom-plugins` via the GitHub API (the repo is not checked out
locally; nothing fabricated).

### Owner ruling recorded

**Decision 1 = drop-all** on `python-project-standards`: NOT folded into the roster. The
`python-standards` plugin's 6 commands are all dropped regardless of merit. (The T-15
"1 python command" framing was off — the plugin actually carries 6.)

### Per-command disposition (all 16)

| # | Command (plugin) | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | dev-focus / focus-check | **migrated** -> new `dev-focus` code-desk skill |
| 2 | dev-focus / scope-review | **migrated** -> same `dev-focus` skill (the scope hammer) |
| 3 | dev-focus / session-summary | dropped — machine-local `session-summary.py` + `~/.claude/.env` secrets + audio; not portable/self-contained |
| 4 | github-projects-board-management / board-setup | dropped — thin wrapper; setup procedure + scripts already in the `github-project-board` roster skill |
| 5 | github-projects-board-management / board-status | dropped — thin wrapper ("following the board-reporting skill"); reporting is a skill concern |
| 6 | github-projects-board-management / board-sync | dropped — thin read-only wrapper around `board-*.py` already shipping in `github-project-board` |
| 7 | github-projects-board-management / board-triage | dropped — thin wrapper; `board-triage` roster skill carries the routine |
| 8 | obsidian-plugin-dev / create | dropped — pure agent router; delegates to obsidian-* skills + scaffolder agent already in the roster |
| 9 | project-dashboard / setup-dashboard | dropped — wrapper around `setup-project-dashboard` skill, not part of this marketplace (separate project-dashboard surface) |
| 10 | project-dashboard / update-dashboard | dropped — wrapper around `update-project-dashboard` skill, not in this marketplace |
| 11 | python-standards / python-fix | dropped — **drop-all ruling** |
| 12 | python-standards / python-init | dropped — drop-all ruling |
| 13 | python-standards / python-validate | dropped — drop-all ruling |
| 14 | python-standards / ty-check-file | dropped — drop-all ruling |
| 15 | python-standards / ty-check | dropped — drop-all ruling |
| 16 | python-standards / ty-install | dropped — drop-all ruling |

**Net: 2 migrated (as 1 skill), 14 dropped.** Rationale for the migrate/drop split: only
`focus-check` + `scope-review` carry reusable, self-contained, identity-neutral content
with no existing roster home. The 8 board/obsidian/dashboard wrappers are thin invocations
whose intent already folds into skills that migrated earlier (or into out-of-scope surfaces),
so ADR 0001's "fold into the paired skill" is already satisfied — dropping loses nothing.

### Gaps flagged (not blocking retirement)

- `board-status` references a `board-reporting` skill that is not in the current roster
  (reporting capability appears not to have migrated as a named skill). Worth confirming
  whether that intent is covered by `github-project-board` or is a genuine gap.

### Part B — repoint `~/.claude/skills/` (run after PR #209 merges)

Current state on this machine (verified): `ls -la ~/.claude/skills/` shows **no**
`hsb3-custom-plugins` symlinks at all — only a `.DS_Store`. The 6 "already broken" links
have already been cleared; there is nothing dangling to repoint right now. So the retirement
is unblocked from the symlink side once the roster change lands.

Steps for the session to run (verbatim):

```bash
# 1. Confirm no stale hsb3-custom-plugins symlinks remain (expect: only .DS_Store)
ls -la ~/.claude/skills/

# 2. Sweep the stray macOS litter file (optional)
rm -f ~/.claude/skills/.DS_Store

# 3. Update the dotfiles-agents marketplace so code-desk carries the new dev-focus skill,
#    then re-run whatever installs the core-tier bundles (per your marketplace install flow),
#    e.g. inside Claude Code:
#      /plugin marketplace update dotfiles-agents
#      /plugin install code-desk@dotfiles-agents      # (or your usual core-tier install)

# 4. Verify zero dangling symlinks (the acceptance check)
ls -l ~/.claude/skills/          # every entry resolves; no red/broken links
find -L ~/.claude/skills -type l -maxdepth 1   # prints nothing = no dangling links

# 5. Only after 1-4 are clean is it safe to delete/archive the hsb3-custom-plugins repo.
```

Acceptance: `ls -l ~/.claude/skills/` shows zero dangling symlinks and
`find -L ~/.claude/skills -type l -maxdepth 1` prints nothing.

Closed via PR #209 (merged to dev; PRs into dev don't auto-close). Disposition: focus-check + scope-review migrated as new code-desk skill dev-focus; python-project-standards (6 commands) dropped per owner ruling (drop-all, taken this waves run); the 4 board-* + obsidian-create + setup/update-dashboard commands (8 total) dropped as thin wrappers already superseded by github-project-board/board-triage and out-of-marketplace dashboard skills; session-summary dropped (secret/script/audio-coupled). Full table on the close-out comment. Part B (repointing ~/.claude/skills/ symlinks) is a machine-local, non-repo action — the crew found there's currently nothing dangling to repoint (the 6 previously-broken links are already gone), so retirement of hsb3-custom-plugins is unblocked once this merge lands.
